newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 85,000T of Brazilian soymeal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 85,000T of Brazilian soymeal.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) bought a total of 85,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal on Tuesday for arrival in July and August, traders said.
They said Andre sold 60,000 tonnes of soymeal at $331.75 a tonne C&F. Arrival for 30,000 tonnes was set by July 15 and another 30,000 tonnes by August 20 to the western port of Inchon.
Continental Grain also sold 25,000 tonnes at $335.00 a tonne C&F for arrival by August 20 to the ports of Kunsan and Ulsan. Premium for the port rotation was set at $1.5 a tonne.
